    if not isinstance(req, dict):

            if not part or part == "." or part == "..":

        content_b64 = m["content_b64"]
        if not isinstance(content_b64, str):
            return False
        try:

        except Exception:
            return False
        if len(content) > 64 * 1024:
            return False
        mode = m["mode"]
        if not isinstance(mode, int) or isinstance(mode, bool) or not (0 <= mode <= 511):

    if second % 2 != 0:

    except ValueError:

def make_dos_time(hour, minute, second):
    """Encode hour/minute/second into DOS time format."""
    return (second >> 1) | (minute << 5) | (hour << 11)


def make_dos_date(year, month, day):
    """Encode year/month/day into DOS date format."""
    return day | (month << 5) | ((year - 1980) << 9)


def build_zip(members, timestamp, comment):
    """Build a ZIP archive in memory."""
    sorted_members = sorted(members, key=lambda m: m["path"])

    year, month, day, hour, minute, second = timestamp
    dos_time = make_dos_time(hour, minute, second)
    dos_date = make_dos_date(year, month, day)

    archive = bytearray()
    local_offsets = []
    cd_entries = []

    for m in sorted_members:
        path_bytes = m["path"].encode("utf-8")
        content = base64.b64decode(m["content_b64"])
        mode = m["mode"]

        # Compress with deflate
        compressed = zlib.compress(content, 9)[2:-4]

        # CRC of uncompressed data
        crc = zlib.crc32(content) & 0xFFFFFFFF

        compressed_size = len(compressed)
        uncompressed_size = len(content)

        local_offset = len(archive)
        local_offsets.append(local_offset)

        # Local file header: Signature(I), ver_needed(H), flags(H), compression(H),
        #                     mod_time(H), mod_date(H), crc(I), comp_size(I),
        #                     uncomp_size(I), fname_len(H), extra_len(H)
        local_header = struct.pack(
            '<IHHHHHIIIHH',
            0x04034B50,            # signature
            20,                    # version needed
            0,                     # flags
            8,                     # compression (deflate)
            dos_time,              # mod time
            dos_date,              # mod date
            crc,                   # crc32
            compressed_size,       # compressed size
            uncompressed_size,     # uncompressed size
            len(path_bytes),       # filename length
            0                      # extra field length
        )

        archive.extend(local_header)
        archive.extend(path_bytes)
        archive.extend(compressed)

        # Central directory entry
        ext_attr = ((0o100000 | mode) << 16)

        # CD entry format: I H H H H H H I I I H H H H H I I
        cd_entry = struct.pack(
            '<IHHHHHHIIIHHHHHII',
            0x02014B50,            # signature
            20,                    # version made by (2.0 = Unix)
            20,                    # version needed
            0,                     # flags
            8,                     # compression
            dos_time,              # mod time
            dos_date,              # mod date
            crc,                   # crc32
            compressed_size,       # compressed size
            uncompressed_size,     # uncompressed size
            len(path_bytes),       # filename length
            0,                     # extra field length
            0,                     # comment length
            0,                     # disk number start
            0,                     # internal file attributes
            ext_attr,              # external attributes
            local_offset           # local header offset
        )

        cd_entries.append(cd_entry + path_bytes)

    # Central directory offset
    cd_offset = len(archive)
    for entry in cd_entries:
        archive.extend(entry)

    cd_size = sum(len(e) for e in cd_entries)

    # End of central directory record
    comment_bytes = comment.encode("utf-8")
    cd_end = struct.pack(
        '<IHHHHIIHI',
        0x06054B50,            # signature
        0,                     # disk number
        0,                     # disk with CD
        len(sorted_members),   # entries on disk
        len(sorted_members),   # total entries
        cd_offset,             # CD offset
        cd_size,               # CD size
        len(comment_bytes),    # comment length
        0                      # comment offset
    )

    archive.extend(cd_end)
    archive.extend(comment_bytes)

    return bytes(archive)


def main():

        req = json.loads(raw)
    except Exception:
        print(json.dumps({"error": "invalid_request"}))
        return

    if not validate_request(req):

    archive_b64 = base64.b64encode(archive).decode("ascii")

    print(json.dumps({"format": "zip", "archive_b64": archive_b64, "sha256": sha256}))
